items.name: ResumeFlow
items.description: Simplify and improve the job hunting experience by integrating LLMs to automate tasks such as resume and cover letter generation, as well as application submission, saving users time and effort.

items.name: AI-Resume-Analyzer-and-LinkedIn-Scraper-using-Generative-AI
items.description: Developed an AI application using LLM to analyze user resumes and provided the summarization, strengths, weaknesses, suggestions, suitable job titles, and also scraping job details from LinkedIn using Selenium. This application reduces time by 30% and helps candidates tailor their resumes effectively.

items.name: Job_search_agent
items.description: Job search Agent (AI) searches and applies to jobs on your behalf, creating tailored applications for positions that match your skills, making your entire job search hassle-free.

license.name: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0

items.name: LinkedIn-AI-Job-Applier-Ultimate
items.description: AI-powered LinkedIn and Indeed job application bot with Playwright automation, LLM integration, data anonymization, and Telegram reporting. Applies to ALL job types (not just Easy Apply), generates custom resumes, and provides skill statistics.

items.name: anchoring-ai
items.description: An open-source no-code tool for teams to collaborate on building, evaluating, and hosting applications leveraging GPT and other large language models. You could easily build and share LLM-powered apps, manage your budget and run batch jobs.

items.name: JobNavigator
items.description: Self-hosted job-hunt automation: scrape career pages and job boards, score jobs against your résumés with AI, tailor résumés and cover letters, auto-fill applications and application questions from your persona, track every application, get Telegram alerts. Chrome extension, five themes, in your local Docker.

items.name: Auto-JobHunter
items.description: 🚀 An industrial-grade AI job application system (BOSS/Liepin/51job).  Workflow: Scraping ➡️ SQLite ➡️ LLM Eval ➡️ RPA Delivery. | 🚀 工业级全自动 AI 求职系统。工作流：自动抓取 ➡️ SQLite 入库 ➡️ LLM 深度评估 ➡️ RPA 静默投递。基于 FastAPI, LangGraph & DrissionPage.

items.name: JobCtrl
items.description: Open-source, local-first job search app for private discovery, evidence-backed fit scoring, truthful resume tailoring, durable workflows, and approval-gated applications.

license.name: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0

items.name: ai-job-scraper
items.description: 🕵️‍♂️ Privacy-focused AI job scraper, local storage, and interactive dashboard. Auto-scrapes AI/ML roles from top companies using ScrapeGraph-AI + LLM and LangGraph Agents, filters for relevance, and provides a Streamlit UI for tracking applications. Built for developers seeking AI careers.

items.name: offeros
items.description: Local-first AI job-application agent: it tracks every application after you apply, explains failures with per-field evidence, and answers questions about your search — while its Chrome side panel fills real ATS forms (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, iCIMS, Workday). Your data and API key never leave your machine.
